There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
The record is active in the system

his window allows you to create and configure chart visualizations that are linked to existing Print Formats. Each chart reads the summary data (grouped totals and calculated indicators) already produced by the Print Format and renders it as a visual graph. You can define multiple charts per Print Format, each with a different chart type and column mapping. The chart does not perform its own aggregation - it relies entirely on the grouping and indicator functions defined in the Print Format Items and Calculations.

PO.Data: Esta ventana permite crear y configurar visualizaciones de graficos vinculadas a Formatos de Impresion existentes. Cada grafico lee los datos resumidos (totales agrupados e indicadores calculados) ya producidos por el Formato de Impresion y los renderiza como un grafico visual. Se pueden definir multiples graficos por Formato de Impresion, cada uno con un tipo de grafico y mapeo de columnas diferente. El grafico no realiza su propia agregacion - depende completamente de las agrupaciones y funciones de indicadores definidas en los Items y Calculos del Formato de Impresion.

Define the general properties of a chart. First select the Print Format that will provide the data, then choose the visualization type (Bar, Line, Pie, etc.). The chart type determines how the Column Roles assigned in the Chart Item tab are interpreted. For example, in a Bar chart the CATEGORY role maps to the X axis and MEASURE maps to the Y axis, while in a Pie chart CATEGORY defines slice labels and MEASURE defines slice sizes. You can create multiple charts for the same Print Format to show different perspectives of the same data.
Define chart headers: select a Print Format, choose the chart type to determine how data is visualized.

Define which columns from the Print Format participate in the chart and what role each one plays. Each item must reference either a Print Format Item (direct column) or a Print Format Calculation (calculated column), but not both. Assign a Column Role to determine how the data is used in the visualization: CATEGORY for grouping dimensions (X axis or slice labels), MEASURE for numeric values (Y axis or slice sizes), SERIES_GROUP to automatically split data into multiple series, or TOOLTIP for additional hover information. The Sequence controls the order of series when multiple MEASURE items exist, and for SCATTER charts determines which measure maps to the X axis (lowest sequence) and which to the Y axis.
Map columns from the Print Format (Items or Calculations) to chart roles.

PO.Data: Defina que columnas del Formato de Impresion participan en el grafico y que rol juega cada una. Cada elemento debe referenciar un Item de Formato de Impresion (columna directa) o un Calculo de Formato de Impresion (columna calculada), pero no ambos. Asigne un Rol de Columna para determinar como se usan los datos en la visualizacion: CATEGORY para dimensiones de agrupacion (eje X o etiquetas de segmento), MEASURE para valores numericos (eje Y o tamano de segmento), SERIES_GROUP para dividir automaticamente los datos en multiples series, o TOOLTIP para informacion adicional al pasar el cursor. La Secuencia controla el orden de las series cuando existen multiples items MEASURE, y para graficos SCATTER determina cual medida mapea al eje X (menor secuencia) y cual al eje Y.
